title: Sand Crab Cottage Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sand Crab Cottage is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionSand Crab CottageWaterColor Beach Community – Sandy Creek Dr, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights:4 bedrooms plus a bonus bunk room at the top of the stairs with two built-in bunks (see room configurations under “Room Details”)4 full bathrooms and 1 half bathSleeps up to 12 guests3,453 sq. ft. of indoor living space, plus 2,025 sq. ft. of outdoor spaceGourmet kitchen with dual sinks, custom cabinetry including a cabinet-covered refrigerator, marble countertops, and premium appliancesSeparate wet bar with Sub-Zero mini-fridge, ice maker, and wine coolerDining area with large 8-chair table (room for more)Spacious screened-in porch with gas fireplace, mounted TV, outdoor lounge area, and additional dining table for 6Brick patio with gas grill and picnic table just beyond the screened porchTwo king master suites, each with separate soaker tubs and custom showersCozy den areaFirst-floor laundry with full-sized washer and dryerDriveway accommodates 3–4 vehiclesFour 26" adult bikes included seasonally (bikes not included Dec–Feb; additional rentals available upon request)Property Overview:Welcome to Sand Crab Cottage – where luxury meets beachside comfort. Kids will delight in the bright coral bunk room and expansive brick patio, perfect for sidewalk chalk and outdoor play. Adults will enjoy elegantly appointed bedrooms, custom draperies, and Carrera marble countertops throughout.The open main living area connects seamlessly to the gourmet kitchen and cozy den, making it easy to prep meals while staying part of the conversation. French doors open to the screened-in porch, featuring a gas fireplace and mounted TV – ideal for cozy evenings or casual dining with the sounds of nature in the background. The front porch swing offers a peaceful spot for reading, napping, or relaxing while waiting for your beachbound crew.Set on one of the largest lots in WaterColor and backing up to the State Forest, Sand Crab Cottage provides tranquil privacy while keeping you close to community amenities. From Camp WaterColor and the beach to Seaside’s food trucks, everything is just a short walk, bike ride, or golf cart drive away.Guest Requirements:When booking, please provide the exact number of adults and children. WaterColor requires wristbands for all guests 5+ years old to access amenities (pools and beach). Wristbands cannot be issued after arrival, and a maximum of 12 guests is allowed per home.Community Amenities:WaterColor is celebrated for its eco-friendly design, blending exceptional amenities with natural beauty:Multiple community poolsCamp WaterColorWaterColor Beach Club & private beach accessWaterColor Town Center with shopping and diningWestern Lake access, the largest coastal dune lake in South WaltonPlaygrounds, parks, and green spacesNature trails and pedestrian pathsWellness amenities including spa, boathouse, and tennis courts (additional fees may apply)Golf Cart & Parking Info:Golf cart rentals must be arranged directly through The Electric Cart Company (one per home; limited availability)Designated driveway parking for 3–4 vehiclesReservation Policies:No smokingPets not allowed (service animals only; advance notice required)Rates exclude taxes and fees50% of total cost due at booking; balance due 60 days prior (or in full if within 60 days of arrival)Optional travel insurance availableCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTRenters must be at least 25 years old and present for the full stay

2nd Floor Queen Guest Bedroom #2: Queen - Access to shared covered balcony
